purpose: Role handoff and acceptance tracking only; never publication authority or a second calendar.

role_assignments.codex: Engineering and release-gate owner: repair and test the local bridge, bind exact evidence, export job cards and reconcile returned results. No self-approval or independent publication.
role_assignments.cowork: Editorial and operations lead: prepare a rolling seven-day plan, source-backed copy and comment drafts; independently review Codex changes and reconcile published results. Never publish the same queue or override gates.
role_assignments.grok: Single designated publishing operator for individually authorized, supported placements: verify exact job, request claim, submit once only after valid acknowledgement and authorization, return evidence. No content rewriting or canonical repo writes.
role_assignments.owner: Retains account control, restricted policy decisions and exact publication approval; role assignment does not mint one-time receipts.

required_before_first_publication: Receiver acknowledgement bound to this handoff ID and exact packet hash, with actual supported channels and evidence-return route
Implemented bridge with tests for denial, duplicate claim, stale approval, altered media, crash and unknown-outcome recovery
Exact approved job from canonical sources; planning READY and role booleans are not authorization
Fresh content-scoped source, merchant/link-structure, privacy, identity, media-hash and watermark/origin evidence
Current quota/gap and permanent dedup across all operators; atomic claim acknowledgement before submission
Unexpired one-time owner receipt and every applicable current policy gate; action-time confirmation where required
Verified permalink and platform/account/content/slot/media match; independent reconciliation before marking success
unknown_outcome_rule: Do not retry, release the claim, or fabricate success. Reconcile platform history and receipt first.

operational_cadence.daily: Cowork reviews seven-day coverage; Codex validates 48-hour eligibility and blockers; Grok consumes only authorized live slots; Cowork independently reconciles results.
operational_cadence.weekly: Review verified affiliate results and defects; change one measurable hypothesis at a time, add a regression test and record before/after evidence. Missing revenue evidence is UNKNOWN, not zero.
operational_cadence.publication_times: Read the approved canonical slot; no fixed time in this handoff grants permission.
